# decision-004: Keep Telegram API credentials and Telethon session databases outside version control; repository diagnostics may report presence and health but never secret values.

- Status: `implemented`
- Freshness: `stable`
- Area: `security`
- Recorded: `2026-10-16`
- Last verified: `2026-10-16`
- Tags: `env`, `secrets`, `session`, `telethon`

## Rationale and consequences

Local .env and .secrets content, session databases, cookies, phone numbers, tokens, and raw exception messages are excluded from records and commits. Session locks are retained when resource closure cannot be confirmed.
